title: ChatAnthropic: SystemMessage v1 content blocks are forwarded verbatim, so create_text_block()'s id causes 400 "system.0.id: Extra inputs are not permitted"
author: jmbledsoe

comments.author: jackjin1997
comments.body: I checked this against current `master`: `_format_messages` still passes dict-valued system blocks through unchanged, while text blocks for other roles are narrowed to Anthropic-supported fields. That accounts for both `invoke` and `count_tokens`, since both reuse the formatted system payload. A focused fix can normalize system text blocks while preserving supported fields such as `cache_control` and `citations`, with regressions for `_format_messages` and the token-count request. Could you assign this to me? I can take it on.

comments.author: Mohith26
comments.body:
I'd like to take this one. Approach: `_format_messages` already narrows human/assistant dict text blocks to the fields Anthropic accepts (`type`, `text`, `cache_control`, `citations`, plus dropping null citation `file_id`), but the system-message branch forwards blocks verbatim, which is how `create_text_block()`'s `lc_` id reaches the API. I'd extract that existing narrowing into a `_format_text_block()` helper and apply it to system text blocks, leaving non-text system blocks untouched. This also fixes `get_num_tokens_from_messages`, which goes through the same path.

Implementation with unit tests (id stripped for `create_text_block`-built system messages, `cache_control` preserved; 241 unit tests passing, ruff clean) is ready on my fork: https://github.com/Mohith26/langchain/tree/fix/anthropic-system-block-extra-fields. Happy to open the PR once assigned.

comments.author: Solaris-star
comments.body:
I dug into this and have a fix ready (was in #39103 before the auto-close).

**Root cause:** In `_format_messages` (chat_models.py), a `SystemMessage` built from `content_blocks` forwards each dict block verbatim:

```python
system = [
    (block if isinstance(block, dict) else {"type": "text", "text": block})
    for block in message.content
]
```

`create_text_block()` mints an `id` (e.g. `"lc_<uuid4>"`) on the block, and that `id` reaches Anthropic's `system` parameter, which rejects it with `system.0.id: Extra inputs are not permitted`.

**Proposed fix:** Allowlist the keys Anthropic accepts on a system text block — `type`, `text`, `cache_control`, `citations` — which is exactly the allowlist already used for text blocks in regular message content (chat_models.py:600-617). This drops the `id` while preserving `cache_control` and `citations`.

I have this implemented with two unit tests (id stripped from a `create_text_block()` system block; `cache_control` preserved), both failing on the unfixed code and passing with the fix, and the full `test_chat_models.py` suite (148 tests) green. Happy to reopen the PR once assigned. Would this approach be acceptable?
